Motion 14.12.0, from the `motion` npm package. `motion.js` is the package's
minified browser bundle (`dist/motion.js`); `index.mjs` exposes its `animate`
as a module, so `import { animate } from "motion"` works through the import
map in `index.html`. The package archive SHA-1 is
`c145fea6f5faca6f5a674e915c5bcb23f0287c2a`.
